name: Godrej Industries Limited
summary: Godrej Industries Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the chemical, agriculture, real estate, vegetable oil, hospitality, and financial and investment businesses in India and internationally. The company produces and sells fatty acids, fatty alcohols, esters and emulsifying waxes, refined glycerin, alpha olefin sulphonates, sodium lauryl sulphate, and sodium lauryl ether sulphate. It also offers compound feeds for cattle, poultry, shrimp, and fish. In addition, the company provides refined vegetable and vanaspati oil; and engages in oil trading and oil palm plantation business.
